scientific_question: At the same one-byte-per-pair carry rate, does joint polar vector quantization encode the discarded Muon direction well enough to pass the frozen causal gate?

causal_basis.observation: Changing from matrix-global to output-group-local Cartesian levels changes carry recovery by at most 0.0023 and is neutral-to-negative after step 40. Scale locality is not causal.
causal_basis.mechanism: The Cartesian codec allocates four independent bits to each coordinate. A polar vector codec instead allocates five bits to the pair direction and three bits to adaptive projected radius, directly preserving the coupled update direction at identical code rate.
causal_basis.distortion_prior: For 32 uniform angle bins, the small-angle relative distortion is approximately (2*pi/32)^2/12 = 0.00321. Eight Lloyd-fitted projected-radius levels are expected to keep total pair distortion below the 0.02 frozen floor if paired direction is the missing geometry.

candidate.name: pair_vq_cproj_fast_residual_plus_polar32x8_sigma_delta
candidate.single_change: Replace the separable 16x16 Cartesian carry decoder with a centered 32-angle x 8-radius vector decoder.
candidate.persistent_code: one uint8 per weight pair, unchanged
candidate.metadata_per_matrix: eight FP32 radii plus one FP32 two-vector center

accounting.extra_codec_work: one atan2, radius projection, three eight-bin Lloyd iterations, and decode per pair per optimizer step; exact-host performance-gated

frozen_gate.expected_duration: under five minutes on PRO6 and therefore foreground-polled; attach a persistent watchdog immediately if observed duration exceeds five minutes

decision_policy.pass: Authorize exactly one matched 124M/0.5TPP endpoint against the sealed QK-only dense-MLP parent. Do not scale up.
decision_policy.codec_fail: Reject two-dimensional paired polar coding at 8 bits per pair; perform rate-distortion theory before changing the bit budget.
decision_policy.systems_fail: Optimize only the implementation of the same polar representation, then repeat the gate.
decision_policy.endpoint_fail_after_gate_pass: Keep the complete representation fixed and localize objective mismatch from fixed-checkpoint loss and functional probes.
